The '''Rock Rogues''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group that operated during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
In about [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the Rock Rogues entered a partnership with [[the Syndicate]], a criminal organization that was led by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Alina Impeveri]]. The Rogues would attack [[Metatheran Cartel]] merchant ships just outside the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], then seize their cargo and take it to the Syndicate's base of operations, in the [[Ishkik caverns]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. However, the [[Heroes of Cularin]] traveled to the caverns and attacked the Syndicate and the Rogues, stopping their operation in the Cularin system.
